name: saved-replies-create-permission-admin
description: part 1 of 2 - the admin restricts one member to using Saved Replies without creating them
resolvedBy: claude-in-chrome walk of app.salesmessage.com, as the admin (Google SSO) and as the member
intro: Saved Replies permissions | Let your team use replies without adding new ones
warnings:
PART 1 OF 2. Part 2 is scenarios/saved-replies-create-permission-member.trace.json; the two finished
clips are joined into one video. Splitting removes the on-camera sign-in, which hit a 2FA
enrolment dialog and a reCAPTCHA.

BEFORE EVERY TAKE: Demo Demo's 'Can create Saved Replies' must be ON. The take turns it OFF, and
the first wait (#cannedMessage:checked) fails fast if it is already off.
profile/ must hold the admin session (Google SSO, signed in by hand). Takes no longer log it out.

Rebuilt from video-qa 2026-10-17: line holds sized from measured TTS length (no overlaps); every line said only once its subject is on screen; the take starts on the loaded Role & Permissions page; the member-page load is left silent so tighten.mjs fast-forwards it.

steps.name: ready
steps.intent: the Member checkbox in the Saved Replies access row, proving Role & Permissions has loaded
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live. Named "ready" so the driver waits for it OFF camera: the take starts on a loaded page (video-qa 2026-10-17: 7.7s of spinner at the start).

steps.name: roleCreateMember
steps.intent: the Member checkbox in the 'Can create Saved Replies' row

steps.text: Saved Replies now have two separate permissions: access, and create.
Access lets someone find and insert replies. Create lets them add, edit, duplicate and delete.

steps.name: roleAccessMember
steps.intent: the Member checkbox in the 'Can access Saved Replies' row
steps.evidence: 1 match, watched live; hover shows "Also removes Create access".

steps.text: Turning access off takes create with it - create depends on access.

steps.name: memberCreate
steps.intent: the checked 'Can create Saved Replies' checkbox on the member's own Permissions page
steps.evidence: :checked fails the take fast if Create is already OFF. The page load measured ~12s in a take (blank spinner, then shell, then rows).

steps.text: The same two settings exist for each member, and they override the role.
This member keeps access, but loses create.
